details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{VCR}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: If $\mathrm{VCR}(\mathcal H)=k$, its definition quantifies over k-element subsets of the effective range.  Thus k cannot exceed the cardinality of that range; the k=0 case is immediate.
name: Effective Range / Effective VC Radius
witness_verification: For #classes/halfintervals with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n-1$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
